name: old asphalt road: mostly one dark warm charcoal tone with an even fine grain of mid-grey aggregate, soft low-frequency paler wheel-worn zones that flow across tiles, rare dark and rare light aggregate pixels; its unconnected edges are a chipped broken rim 1 to 3 pixels deep that varies continuously along the road, lighter broken faces on the far (north) rim, irregular rounded-off ends at dead ends and outer corners, and a dry dark-brown ledge 1 to 2 pixels thick with a broken soil shadow on the south side; laid as a road network with crossroads, dead ends and long straight 1-wide and 3-wide runs (cracks and potholes are separate decals)
label: wasteland_ruins/asphalt-ph

name: an asymmetric dark grey-black crack: one long wandering diagonal stem with a single short side branch on one side and a tiny spur on the other, a short dirt-filled opening along the stem and lit lips under its flatter stretches, drawn as a transparent decal on old asphalt
label: wasteland_ruins/road-crack-b

name: a wide irregular broken-asphalt pothole, about 14 px across, seen from a 3/4 top-down view: its dirt floor is darker than the road, the far inner wall is the darkest shadow, only a thin strip of lit earth shows on the near inner wall, the near and side rims are broken lighter asphalt edges, and a few loose asphalt fragments lie around it; transparent decal on old asphalt
label: wasteland_ruins/pothole-a

name: a pothole made of two small eroded basins joined by a narrow neck, lying diagonally, with dark dirt floors darker than the road, shadowed far walls, a thin lit near inner wall, broken lighter near rims and a couple of loose fragments; transparent decal on old asphalt
label: wasteland_ruins/pothole-b
